verdict.line: You lose if you let Sion free-hit you with Cryptic Gaze before level 3; you win if you stack Darkness Rise and pull him with Death's Grasp into isolated trades.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser holds the lane edge (52.4% over 143 games, solo-kill advantage) because Death's Grasp both interrupts Sion's Cryptic Gaze and sets up Obliterate's single-target bonus damage, while Indestructible's stored shield absorbs the burst Sion needs to win a trade. Sion's counter-play is time: Enrage has no cooldown and grows his max HP on every kill, so if the lane drags into late game without Mordekaiser closing fights fast, Sion's stacked health starts to out-tank the burn.

theirWindow.when: Cryptic Gaze (Q) is off cooldown, you're overextended
theirWindow.what: At levels 1-2 his Q stuns and deals damage before you have Indestructible online. Don't commit to extended trades near his stun range until your W is up to shield the follow-up damage.

yourWindow.when: your passive (P) is stacked and E is up
yourWindow.what: Land three spells or autos to trigger Darkness Rise's aura and move speed, then fire Death's Grasp to pull Sion in — this interrupts his Cryptic Gaze cast and chains straight into Obliterate's single-target bonus damage.

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping adaptive force rewards the melee-range trading pattern Obliterate and auto resets create against Sion.

playing.title: Pull through his Cryptic Gaze cast
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read confirms Death's Grasp interrupts Sion's Q — use E the moment he commits to the cast rather than waiting for the stun to land.

playing.title: Stack passive before you engage
playing.detail: Land three hits to trigger Darkness Rise's aura and move speed before you extend; fighting without it active lets Sion walk away from your pull.

playing.title: Bank Indestructible for his all-in
playing.detail: Let the shield charge off damage dealt and taken, then consume it to heal right as he commits his Enrage-boosted autos.

playing.title: Punish him while Enrage is active
playing.detail: Enrage costs him health per auto with no cooldown gate — trade hardest while he's actively autoing, since that's when his effective HP is lowest.

playing.title: Use Realm of Death to isolate, not just burst
playing.detail: At level 6+, drag Sion away from minions and allies before committing — the stolen stats and forced 1v1 matter more than the raw damage.

playing.title: End fights fast past level 12
playing.detail: His max HP grows with every kill and Cannibalism heals him and nearby allies — avoid dragging trades out once he's stacked several kills.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells are pulled from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning behind the trade timing and power spikes is my own read of the matchup.
